title: Places I’ve visited in my dreams the last week
content: Image one: I was in a Goodwill and really needed to pee. A staff member led me to a door that went down into the basement, and all across the walls of the staircase were various doors that all led to differently themed single stall bathrooms. Image two: I was passing through a house after a long road trip. For some reason, on the wall there was a demonic portal. I didn’t go in it. Image three: This was last night. I was at a camp/farm, and there was a tall mountain in the distance with a winding road that led up it to a playground. I remember halfway through the dream it started to rain like nothing I’ve ever seen before. The place was in a long drought before then. Image four: This is my second time actually being to this place. It’s a pond that’s hidden under multiple weeping willows, and many streams and rivers lead into it which made the waters choppy and hard to control your kayak in. Both last time and this time, I was here crying about a dream character that was about to die. Last time was chronic heart failure, and this time was cancer. I would cry and cry begging to whatever god is out there not to take away this person, but it was no use. (All images are AI generated from Gemini)
